name: Nagumo Kazuma
source:
Self-proclaimed detective who doesn't even belong to any detective agency. Also, he is an extremely heavy smoker.

Special skills: Good at brewing coffee.
A place he attends a lot: Fuchu Racecourse.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
